hero.title: Connecting Farmers to a Smarter Tomorrow
hero.sub: FarmDirect connects farmers and buyers directly using AI-powered insights, fair pricing, demand forecasting, and smarter agricultural decisions.
stats.disclaimer: Platform highlights — illustrative figures for this demo build.
features.heading: Smart Agriculture Powered by AI
features.sub: Every listing on FarmDirect is backed by models that read market signals so farmers don't have to guess.
features.priceBody: Helps farmers understand a suitable price range for their produce before they list it.
features.demandBody: Uses AI-powered demand predictions across nearby markets to support better selling decisions.
features.matchingBody: Connects farmers with suitable buyers based on the produce, quantity and requirements.
features.logisticsBody: Helps optimize delivery and transportation decisions once a sale is agreed.
marketplace.previewSub: A live look at what farmers are listing right now, with an AI fair-price check on every item.
how.heading: How FarmDirect Works
how.sub: From listing to sale, in four simple steps.
how.step1Body: Farmer adds produce details, quantity, price, and availability.
how.step2Body: FarmDirect AI analyzes market information and provides useful insights.
how.step3Body: The system helps connect farmers with suitable buyers.
how.step4Body: Farmers and buyers complete the transaction and manage the order.
price.heading: Know Your Price Before You Sell
price.body: Before listing produce, farmers get an AI-recommended price range built from recent market prices, demand trends and nearby buyer activity — so it's easier to price fairly and sell with confidence.
benefits.heading: Built Around the Farmer
benefits.sub: FarmDirect AI exists to put decision-making power back in the hands of the people growing the food.
benefits.sellBody: Connect with buyers and reduce unnecessary intermediaries.
benefits.decisionsBody: Use AI insights to understand demand and market conditions.
benefits.pricesBody: Use AI-supported price recommendations before listing produce.
benefits.reachBody: Make your produce visible to a wider marketplace.
cta.heading: Ready to sell smarter?
cta.sub: Join farmers and buyers already trading directly on FarmDirect AI.
